title: Closed localization for arbitrary pro-etale ring-sheaf module objects
statement: Let X be qcqs, i:Z→X closed and j:U→X quasi-compact open with complementary ranges, and B an arbitrary ring object in abelian pro-etale sheaves. For the operations [def-sf-proetale-ring-sheaf-operations], i_* preserves finite colimits; the actual counit i^*i_*G→G is an isomorphism for every G; j^*i_*G is zero; and for every B-module M the actual counit j_!j^*M→M is mono, the actual unit M→i_*i^*M is epi, and these maps form an exact sequence.

source.place: Proof parts (2)--(3); Stacks Tags 09AA, 09BM, 09AG, 09AH; module actions Tag 03DA

proof.text: Use the abelian supported-unit theorem: if both restrictions of F are zero, its closed unit identifies F with the direct image of a zero object. Forgetting module actions reflects zero objects. Exact module inverse image commutes with kernels and cokernels, so the two restrictions jointly reflect isomorphisms by the mono/epi criterion.

The carrier of the lifted closed counit is precisely the abelian closed counit, by mapModAdjunction_counit_app_hom. Reflect its invertibility through Mod.forget. For disjoint ranges, isZero_openImmersionRestriction_lowerStar and upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction give zero open restriction of closed direct image. Faithfulness of Mod.forget lifts this vanishing. The open module unit is invertible because its carrier is the abelian fully faithful open-extension unit.

Adjunction transposition proves i^*j_!N=0 and that the actual open counit followed by the closed unit is zero. Form the resulting ShortComplex. On the closed piece its first term vanishes and its second arrow is invertible by the closed triangle identity; on the open piece its last term vanishes and its first arrow is invertible by the open triangle identity. JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.shortExact_iff for the pair of exact restrictions reflects these short exact sequences. Convert its exactness to ComposableArrows.Exact.

For an epimorphism on Z, naturality and invertibility of the closed counit make the closed restriction of its direct image epi. Exact restrictions commute with the cokernel. Closed restriction of this cokernel is zero; its open restriction is zero because both closed direct images have zero open restriction. Joint zero detection kills the cokernel, so direct image preserves epimorphisms. It preserves limits as a right adjoint. Apply preservesHomology_of_preservesEpis_and_kernels and preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology.

lean.statement:
theorem ringSheaf_closed_localization
    {X Z U : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j]
    [QuasiCompact j] (_hU : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (B : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj B] :
    PreservesFiniteColimits (ringSheafDirectImage i B) ∧
    (∀ G, IsIso ((ringSheafAdjunction i B).counit.app G)) ∧
    (∀ G, IsZero ((ringSheafInverseImage j B).obj ((ringSheafDirectImage i B).obj G))) ∧
    (∀ M, Mono ((ringSheafOpenAdjunction j B).counit.app M) ∧
      Epi ((ringSheafAdjunction i B).unit.app M) ∧
      (ComposableArrows.mk₂ ((ringSheafOpenAdjunction j B).counit.app M)
        ((ringSheafAdjunction i B).unit.app M)).Exact)
